business: PetMetro (cat food, treats and cat milk; mall booth in Miri, Sarawak)
target: Cat owners living in Miri, Sarawak, Malaysia, who shop at Permy Mall and buy cat food at least twice a month. All money is in Malaysian Ringgit (RM), including your yearly income

behaviours.name: Supermarket Whiskas buyer
behaviours.how: Buys Whiskas with the weekly groceries: 80g pouches at about RM 2 each and a 1.2kg bag of dry food at about RM 15 to RM 17.

behaviours.name: Budget bulk buyer
behaviours.how: Buys the cheapest big bag of dry food at the pet shop and gives wet food only as an occasional treat.

behaviours.name: Online deal hunter
behaviours.how: Orders cat food on Shopee during sales and compares the price per pack before buying anything.

behaviours.name: New cat owner
behaviours.how: Got a first cat within the last year, is still trying different foods, and asks friends and Facebook groups what to feed.

behaviours.name: Feeds many cats
behaviours.how: Feeds four or more cats, including strays, so the cost per meal matters most.

behaviours.name: Premium feeder
behaviours.how: Pays more for brands the vet or pet shop recommends and reads the ingredient list.

objections: I have never heard of this brand. Is it safe for my cat?
Where is it made? Nobody says.
It says no pork, but is it actually halal-certified?
It costs more than Whiskas. Why should I switch?
My cat is fussy. What if it won't eat it?
Can I still buy it after this mall event ends?
habits: you do the weekly grocery run at a mall in Miri and walk past the event booths on the way in
you have one indoor cat and buy its food together with the family groceries
you feed your two cats plus a few strays behind the house
you scroll Facebook and Shopee for pet deals most evenings
your family keeps a halal home, so you check the ingredients of anything you bring in
you adopted your first kitten a few months ago
